observed_scale_before_policy.interpretation: capacity planning only; values are not Oracle outcomes

mechanism_replay_snapshot_rule: for each frozen calibration trajectory and phase, retain the target with lowest sha256(selection_key/state_id) rank; this rule cannot inspect discrepancy
always_retain: source metadata and source-binding capture audit
per-state small result JSON, endpoint banks, record bundles and record validations
single-trajectory signed U2 mean-field shards and summary
all confirmation precision, bank, manifest and evaluator hashes
a tombstone ledger containing path, byte size and sha256 for every removed artifact
the twelve calibration mechanism-replay full snapshots selected above
large_artifact_classes_potentially_eligi: per-state paired update-delta safetensors after signed trajectory U2 aggregation
source_final_model weights after every frozen state record and trajectory aggregate validate
deletion_gate: all 24 state records for the trajectory are population-eligible and freshly revalidated
the trajectory scalar summary is valid and complete without endpoint deletion
the signed U2 trajectory summary and every retained mean-field shard validate
every downstream multi-trajectory consumer needed by the current stage has completed
a pre-deletion ledger hashes every candidate and names its retained derived consumer
an independent validator confirms no candidate is required by a frozen confirmation or contributor endpoint
the deletion command is separately reviewed; this policy never deletes automatically
confirmation_incremental_rule: if precision J cannot fit above the storage safety floor, incremental pruning requires a separately validated per-trajectory scalar and any frozen U2-direction projection before the next source trajectory; otherwise confirmation is infeasible at the declared J
nonclaims: a retained hash cannot reconstruct deleted raw tensors
derived summaries do not provide full raw replayability
